description: List recent wallet transactions with pagination. Returns an array of transactions including sends, receives, and multi-currency operations. Each entry includes amounts, confirmations, block info, and — for multi-currency transactions — token amounts and reserve output details. Results are returned most-recent-last.

count.description: Number of transactions to return. Default: 10.

from.description: Number of transactions to skip (for pagination). Default: 0.

name: listtransactions
